tagline: Securely connecting everything to accelerate digital transformation
hero_kpi_rationale: Security revenue is a key segment for Cisco, with 59% growth in 2025, reflecting the successful integration of Splunk and the strategic priority placed on security and observability solutions.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.description: Cisco's revenue increased by 5% in 2025, driven by growth across all geographic regions and the full contribution from Splunk.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.description: Cisco's gross margin increased by 0.2 point in 2025, due to improvements in productivity and cost management, partially offset by amortization related to Splunk.
kpis.signal: 0.2 point improvement in gross margin in 2025

kpis.name: Security Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the Security segment including Splunk
kpis.description: Security revenue grew by 59% in 2025, primarily driven by Splunk's contribution and increased demand for security and observability solutions.
kpis.signal: 59% growth observed in the Security segment in 2025

kpis.name: Research and Development
kpis.description: Cisco's research and development expenses increased by 16% in 2025 to support innovation in networking, security, collaboration, and observability.
kpis.signal: 16% increase in research and development expenses in 2025

kpis.name: Operating Income Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income as a percentage of revenue
kpis.description: Cisco's operating income margin decreased by 1.8 points in 2025, primarily due to higher amortization of intangible assets and stock-based compensation expenses related to Splunk.
kpis.signal: 1.8 point decline in operating income margin in 2025

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Cisco's net income declined by 1% in 2025 to $10.18 billion, despite revenue growth, due to higher costs from acquisitions and amortization.
kpis.signal: Slight 1% decline in net income in 2025

kpis.name: Earnings Per Share
kpis.description: Cisco's diluted earnings per share remained flat at $2.55 in 2025, reflecting effective cost management despite margin pressures.
kpis.signal: Stability in earnings per share in 2025

kpis.name: Cash and Cash Equivalents
kpis.description: Cisco's cash and cash equivalents decreased by 9% in 2025 to $16.11 billion, due to share repurchases and dividend payments.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Cisco's total debt decreased by 9% in 2025 to $28.09 billion, reflecting active capital structure management and debt repayment.

risks.title: Litigation Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company had a legal dispute with a supplier in Q4 2025 resulting in a charge; future litigation risks remain

risks.title: Tax Risk
risks.score_rationale: Potential changes in tax laws could impact tax rates and international tax obligations

risks.title: Competition Risk
risks.score_rationale: Cisco operates in a highly competitive market; its position is maintained through continuous innovation and integrated solutions

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risk
risks.score_rationale: Cisco provides security solutions and is therefore exposed to significant risks if its own systems are compromised

risks.title: Tariff and Trade Policy Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly cites complexity related to tariffs and trade policy as an environmental factor

ai_positioning.summary: Cisco is actively integrating artificial intelligence across its product portfolios in networking, security, collaboration, and observability. AI is positioned as a key element of the technology simplification and customer value creation strategy.
evidence: Incorporation of AI into networking, security, collaboration, and observability portfolios
59% growth in Security segment revenue, largely driven by Splunk and AI-powered observability solutions
Growth in AI infrastructure revenue from webscale customers in the service provider and cloud segment
